answer: I would stop farms with epoch-scoped anonymous token per verified identity, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 529 pays 8993 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The timber test is the live device, the island test is the locked stake, and the lantern test is the graded history no template can fake. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
